coaching_hero_price_amount: Online from {online} / On-site from {onsite} per day
coaching_hero_summary: We build routines from scratch, polish the one you have, or work with you from the basics up. Online or in person at your gym. Our routines have been performed at the All-Japan and other national championships.
coaching_hero_welcome: Whatever you need, we can help. Just get in touch!
coaching_hero_note: A direct message on Instagram reaches us fastest. Quotes are free.
coaching_ways_title: Online, or in person at your gym
coaching_ways_lead: Each format covers different ground, so pick the one that fits what you need.
coaching_way_online_summary: Send us a video, or talk face to face on screen
coaching_way_online_point_review: We watch a video of the routine and give you our advice
coaching_way_online_point_advice: We talk through your routine (apparatus handling, matching the music)
coaching_way_online_note: Building a group routine from scratch needs us to see the gymnasts move, so we only take that on in person.
coaching_way_offline_summary: We come to your gym and work with you directly
coaching_way_offline_point_group: Build a group routine from scratch
coaching_way_offline_point_individual: Build or fix an individual routine
coaching_way_offline_point_basics: Work on basics, tumbling and apparatus handling
coaching_way_offline_note: Travel and accommodation are billed separately, at cost.
coaching_prices_lead: The figure changes with the work and the number of gymnasts. Talk to us first and we will send a quote.
coaching_price_online_review_individual_: We watch the video and give you our advice
coaching_price_online_review_group_note: More gymnasts to watch, so it costs more than individual
coaching_price_travel_note: Please book train and plane tickets in advance
coaching_price_lodging_note: Please book the room in advance as well
coaching_market_open: Read how we think about the going rate
coaching_market_lead: Men’s rhythmic gymnastics has few athletes, and no settled rate for coaching or choreography. Since you probably have no idea what “normal” looks like, here is how we think about it.
coaching_market_onsite_body: means setting aside a whole day and travelling to you. At the going rate for private sports coaching — ¥3,000–5,000 an hour — both the half day and the full day sit at the lower end of that range.
coaching_market_create_body: involves listening to the music, building the routine, filming it and writing it out. Each routine takes several days.
coaching_market_review_body: is just watching a video and sending back notes, so it is the easiest place to start.
coaching_market_note: We can shape the work around your budget. “How far can we get for this much?” is a perfectly good question to ask.
coaching_results_lead: Including routines performed at the All-Japan and other national championships.
coaching_continuous_kabusho: Alumni routines for the Kabusho Rhythmic Gymnastics Club recitals (13th–22nd)
coaching_flow_consult_description: Tell us when, where, how many gymnasts and how far you want to go. Direct messages are welcome.
coaching_flow_decide_description: We settle the format (online or on-site), the price and the dates. Quotes are free.
coaching_flow_work_description: We watch your video and send back notes, or work with you at the gym. Routines take shape in conversation with you.
coaching_flow_deliver_description: You get the routine as a video plus a written breakdown. Later tweaks can be arranged too.
coaching_contact_lead: When, where, how many gymnasts, how far. It is fine if some of it is still undecided. We can shape the work around your budget.
coaching_contact_note: A reply can take a few days. Quotes are free.
coaching_other_background_music_body: We build the music around the routine.
coaching_other_decorating_apparatus_body: We finish your apparatus in your team’s colours.
